title: Moodlight
summary: A hands-on workshop building a Wi-Fi-controlled RGB light at FabLab Bayreuth.
content:
I helped organize Arduino Day 2023 at FabLab Bayreuth and led the Moodlight workshop.

From soldering to control

Participants soldered their own light and controlled its LED colour from a phone or computer. The microcontroller can join an existing Wi-Fi network or create its own network for connecting to the light.

The workshop combines practical electronics with a browser-accessible control interface. The accompanying source material is available in the FabLab Bayreuth repository.
